Settings.QueryText: SELECT AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Period AS Period, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder AS Recorder, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.RecordType AS RecordType, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Quantity AS Amount, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.PointInTime AS PointInTime, CASE WHEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder REFS Document.BonusesPayment THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsPayment, CASE WHEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder REFS Document.BonusesPayment AND ISNULL(AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.IsActivateCertificate, FALSE) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsActivateCertificate, AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.OperationType AS OperationType, CASE WHEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder REFS Document.BonusesPayment THEN AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Payment ELSE AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Recorder.Source END AS RecorderSource FROM AccumulationRegister.Bonuses AS AccumulationRegisterBonuses WHERE AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Card = &qCard AND AccumulationRegisterBonuses.Quantity <> 0

SELECT InformationRegisterDiscounts.Period AS Period, InformationRegisterDiscounts.DiscountType AS DiscountType, InformationRegisterDiscounts.ServiceGroup AS ServiceGroup, InformationRegisterDiscounts.Hotel AS Hotel, InformationRegisterDiscounts.Discount AS Discount FROM InformationRegister.Discounts AS InformationRegisterDiscounts WHERE InformationRegisterDiscounts.DiscountType = &qDiscountType

SELECT InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.Period AS Period, InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.DiscountType AS DiscountType, InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.ResourceLimit AS ResourceLimit, InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.ServiceGroup AS ServiceGroup, InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.Discount AS Discount FROM InformationRegister.AccumulatingDiscounts AS InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts WHERE InformationRegisterAccumulatingDiscounts.DiscountType = &qDiscountType
